name: mcp-bridge
title: MCP Bridge for ChatGPT
description: Host any npm MCP server as HTTP/SSE endpoint for ChatGPT

input.title: MCP Bridge Input
input.description: Configure which npm MCP server to host

package.title: NPM Package
package.description: The npm package name of the MCP server (e.g., @anthropic/mcp-server-fetch)

version.title: Package Version
version.description: Optional: specific version to install (e.g., 1.0.0). Defaults to latest.

args.title: CLI Arguments
args.description: Optional: command line arguments to pass to the MCP server

env.title: Environment Variables
env.description: Optional: environment variables for the MCP server (e.g., API keys)
